records.title: Image Captioning With Controllable and Adaptive Length Levels
records.reason: IEEE publisher full text was unavailable, and the accessible full-text copy was on a prohibited GitHub Pages host, so it was not opened. Metadata indicates controllable-length image captioning and faster non-autoregressive generation; without primary article text, the vision-captioning result remains borderline.

records.title: NEXUS: Network Exploration for eXploiting Unsafe Sequences in Multi-Turn LLM Jailbreaks
records.reason: NEXUS benchmarks multi-turn LLM jailbreaks and unsafe-sequence exploration. It is security evaluation rather than a technique for inference efficiency.

records.title: Just KIDDIN: Knowledge Infusion and Distillation for Detection of INdecent Memes
records.reason: Just KIDDIN combines knowledge infusion and distillation to detect indecent memes. The evaluated task is content moderation/classification and no inference-efficiency mechanism is reported.

records.title: The Mystery of the Pathological Path-star Task for Language Models
records.reason: The paper investigates a pathological language-model task as a diagnostic of reasoning/generalization. It analyzes capability behavior, not inference compute, memory, or serving.

records.title: PreQuant: A Task-agnostic Quantization Approach for Pre-trained Language Models
records.reason: PreQuant quantizes pre-trained language models before fine-tuning and evaluates task performance under lower precision. Its goal is task-agnostic model quantization, but the evaluated workflow centers on fine-tuning and does not establish a deployed inference-speed benefit; retain as a weak quantization lineage connection.
